conservativeQuarantines.name: Tóváros
conservativeQuarantines.explanation: The conservative catalogue validator rejects a point-tangent hole arrangement although GEOS considers the original geometry valid. The candidate remains quarantined; no source geometry was repaired or changed.

duplicatePreference.name: Belváros
duplicatePreference.explanation: The admitted manual candidate duplicates an existing machine-source feature; catalogue deduplication prefers the machine source, so this candidate adds no unique manual catalogue contribution.

integrationValidation.interpretation: Review approval, pipeline validation and unique catalogue contribution are separate counts. The registry preserves all 47 reviewed source candidates; 46 pass the conservative geometry loader and 45 contribute unique manual catalogue records.

initialBatchScope: The original per-feature decisions and integration counts below describe the initial66-feature batch. Continuation datasets have their own linked independent reviews/proofs.
